title: HandLive — relay op error (relay → device)
description: 0.7.3, CONN-03 API 5, PAIR-01 API 7: a frame the relay refused. message is an English diagnostic for logs, never shown (0.12.4). The HTTP error body of the REST API is relay-rest.schema.json#/$defs/error-response.

code.description: NOT_PAIRED (0.8.2): the destination is not the peer of a valid pair; NOT_CONNECTED (0.8.1): the peer has no relay connection; PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: frame > 256 KiB; RATE_LIMITED; BAD_REQUEST: malformed frame, or a rendezvous that is full or expired.

to.description: Destination of the refused frame, when there is one.
